intro: The civil partner visa is for people in a civil partnership with a British citizen or settled person. It follows the same rules as the spouse visa, and we check your evidence just as carefully.
cardText: For civil partners of British or settled people.

checklist.item: Your partner is British or settled

purposesTitle: Who the civil partner visa covers

purposes.title: Overseas relationships
purposes.text: Recognised as civil partnerships in UK law.

purposes.title: Proposed civil partners
purposes.text: Use the fiancé(e) route to register in the UK.

notCovered: An overseas partnership not recognised in UK law

documentsTable.details: Both partners’ current and previous passports.
With a certified translation if needed.

Tenancy agreement or property documents, and permission from the owner if needed.

rules.title: The financial requirement
rules.text: Most new applications need £29,000 a year from income, savings or both. Some sponsors who receive certain benefits are exempt. [Read our financial requirement guide](/spouse-visa-financial-requirement/)

rules.title: English language
rules.text: A1 for a first application, A2 when you extend, and B1 for settlement, unless you are exempt. [Read our English language guide](/english-language-requirement/)

rules.title: Route to settlement
rules.text: Partners of British citizens keep a 5-year route to Indefinite Leave to Remain under the government’s plans. [Read about the ILR changes](/ilr-changes-2026/)

boxTitle: Want a second pair of eyes before you apply?
boxText: A consultation costs far less than a refused application. We’ll check your case against the current rules and tell you honestly where you stand.

sections.heading: Civil partner visa requirements
sections.text: The civil partner visa has the same requirements as the spouse visa: a genuine and continuing relationship, the intention to live together permanently in the UK, the financial requirement, English language and adequate accommodation. Opposite-sex and same-sex civil partnerships are both covered.

sections.heading: Registering in the UK
sections.text: If you plan to register your civil partnership in the UK, apply for the [fiancé(e) visa](/fiance-visa-uk/) as a proposed civil partner first.

faqs.q: Is the civil partner visa different from the spouse visa?
faqs.a: No. The rules are the same; only the relationship document differs.
Many are. We check whether yours is recognised in UK law.
